# jquery.app

> You might not need AI for every web task. jquery.app provides small browser tools that solve everyday HTML, CSS, SEO, mobile UI and publishing tasks with deterministic output — no uploads, accounts, or AI token costs.

Solve everyday HTML, CSS, SEO, mobile UI and publishing tasks with fast browser tools. No uploads, accounts, or AI token costs.

## Core Workflows

- [GitHub Pages publishing workflow](https://www.jquery.app/collections/github-pages-workflow/): CNAME, DNS, sitemap, robots.txt, 404, canonical checks — the full static publishing checklist.
- [Blog publisher toolkit](https://www.jquery.app/collections/blog-publisher/): Front matter, URL slugs, reading time, RSS/JSON feeds, social previews.
- [Multilingual site setup](https://www.jquery.app/collections/multilingual-site/): Hreflang tags, canonical URLs, sitemap planning for translated pages.
- [Beginner CSS tools](https://www.jquery.app/collections/beginner-css/): Clamp calculator, safe area insets, flexbox generator, border radius builder, and more.

## Tool Categories

- [SEO Tools](https://www.jquery.app/tools/seo/): Small browser tools for metadata, indexing, canonical URLs, social previews, and static site launch checks.
- [HTML Tools](https://www.jquery.app/tools/html/): Copy-paste helpers for cleaner HTML tags, head markup, snippets, and publishing workflows.
- [CSS Tools](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css/): Practical CSS generators for responsive layouts, spacing, mobile polish, and everyday UI fixes.
- [Image & Asset Tools](https://www.jquery.app/tools/assets/): Local helpers for icons, image markup, asset paths, and static website files.
- [GitHub Pages Tools](https://www.jquery.app/tools/github-pages/): Tools for custom domains, static publishing, launch checks, and GitHub Pages website maintenance.

## Tools

- [AI Crawler robots.txt Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/ai-crawler-robots-txt-builder/): Build a robots.txt policy for AI crawlers. Choose from open, selective, or strict presets and block specific AI training bots while allowing search engines.
- [ARIA Live Region Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/aria-live-region-generator/): Generate accessible ARIA live region HTML snippets with role, aria-live, aria-atomic, and aria-relevant attributes. Includes optional JavaScript update function.
- [Assetlinks & AASA Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/assetlinks-aasa-generator/): Generate Android assetlinks.json and Apple App Site Association (AASA) files for Universal Links and Android App Links.
- [Cache-Control Header Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/cache-control-header-builder/): Build correct Cache-Control HTTP headers for static assets, HTML pages, feeds, and sensitive content.
- [Container Query Units Calculator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/container-query-units-calculator/): Calculate clamp() values using container query units (cqi, cqw, cqb, cqmin, cqmax) for component-level responsive sizing.
- [COOP/COEP/CORP Header Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/coop-coep-corp-header-builder/): Build Cross-Origin isolation headers for SharedArrayBuffer, WebAssembly threads, and cross-origin security. Choose from presets with debugging checklists.
- [CORS Header Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/cors-header-generator/): Generate CORS HTTP headers for any origin, method, and credential configuration. Output in raw HTTP, Nginx, Apache, Express, or Cloudflare Workers format.
- [CSP Hash Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/csp-hash-generator/): Generate CSP hash values for inline scripts and styles. Hash exact code content with SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512 and get the matching CSP directive snippet.
- [CSS Carousel Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-carousel-generator/): Generate native CSS carousel markup with scroll-snap, scroll buttons, scroll markers, and accessible list structure. No JavaScript required.
- [CSS Scroll-State Query Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-scroll-state-query-generator/): Generate CSS scroll-state() container queries for styling snapped, stuck, or scrollable elements. Includes JavaScript fallback for cross-browser support.
- [CSS Subgrid Layout Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-subgrid-layout-generator/): Generate parent grid and child subgrid CSS. Create layouts where nested grid items align with the parent grid tracks.
- [Customizable Select Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/customizable-select-generator/): Generate CSS for customizable select elements using appearance: base-select, picker icons, checkmarks, and open/closed state styling.
- [Declarative Shadow DOM Snippet Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/declarative-shadow-dom-snippet-generator/): Generate HTML snippets for Declarative Shadow DOM with scoped CSS, slots, open/closed mode, and server-rendering fallback content.
- [Focus Ring CSS Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/focus-ring-css-generator/): Generate accessible :focus-visible outline or box-shadow focus ring CSS with contrast checking against background colors.
- [Hreflang Sitemap Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/hreflang-sitemap-builder/): Build XML sitemap entries with hreflang alternates for multilingual pages. Validate reciprocal links between language versions.
- [Hreflang Tag Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/hreflang-tag-generator/): Generate clean hreflang tags for multilingual static websites.
- [HTML Invoker Command Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/html-invoker-command-generator/): Generate declarative command buttons for dialogs, popovers, and disclosure elements using the Invoker Commands API. No JavaScript needed.
- [HTML Sanitizer Config Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/html-sanitizer-config-builder/): Generate Sanitizer API and DOMPurify allowlist configurations. Choose content-type presets or customize allowed tags and attributes for safe HTML rendering.
- [HTTP Header Parser & Explainer](https://www.jquery.app/tools/http-header-parser-explainer/): Paste raw HTTP response headers and get a grouped, plain-English explanation of each header. Includes security advisories for missing security headers.
- [llms.txt Validator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/llms-txt-validator/): Validate llms.txt files against the specification. Check H1 headings, blockquote summaries, section structure, and Markdown link formatting.
- [Open Graph & Twitter Card Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/og-twitter-card-builder/): Build social preview meta tags for blog posts and static pages.
- [GitHub Pages CNAME Helper](https://www.jquery.app/tools/github-pages-cname-helper/): Create the CNAME file content and DNS notes for a GitHub Pages custom domain.
- [OpenSearch Description Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/opensearch-description-generator/): Generate an OpenSearch description XML file and HTML link tag so browsers can add your site's search as a search engine.
- [PWA Maskable Icon Safe Zone Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/pwa-maskable-icon-safe-zone-generator/): Upload an app icon and preview the PWA maskable safe zone with overlay. Export manifest-ready icon entries with correct purpose and size references.
- [Redirect Map Converter](https://www.jquery.app/tools/redirect-map-converter/): Convert a CSV redirect map to Netlify _redirects, netlify.toml, Vercel vercel.json, Apache .htaccess, or Nginx config. Validate duplicates and redirect chains.
- [security.txt Generator & Validator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/security-txt-generator-validator/): Generate and validate security.txt files per RFC 9116. Specify your contact, expiration, and optional fields, then get hosting guidance for GitHub Pages, Netlify, and Vercel.
- [SRI Hash Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/sri-hash-generator/): Generate Subresource Integrity hashes for script and stylesheet files. Paste code, upload a local file, or reference a CDN URL and get the integrity attribute for your HTML tags.
- [Static Site SEO Checklist Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/static-site-seo-checklist-generator/): Generate a practical SEO checklist for static websites before launch.
- [Robots Meta Tag Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/robots-meta-tag-generator/): Generate page-level robots meta tags without guessing directive syntax.
- [Canonical URL Tag Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/canonical-url-tag-generator/): Generate canonical link tags for static pages and blog posts.
- [HTML Link Rel Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/html-link-rel-generator/): Generate link tags for preload, preconnect, dns-prefetch, canonical, and alternate URLs.
- [Favicon HTML Tag Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/favicon-html-tag-generator/): Generate favicon and web app icon tags for static websites.
- [CSS Clamp Calculator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-clamp-calculator/): Calculate responsive CSS clamp values for font sizes and spacing.
- [CSS Safe Area Insets Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-safe-area-insets-generator/): Generate CSS for safe-area insets on phones with notches and rounded corners.
- [llms.txt Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/llms-txt-generator/): Create an llms.txt file for AI search and answer engines.

- [JSON-LD Starter Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/json-ld-starter-builder/): Generate starter JSON-LD for WebSite, Organization, Article, FAQ, or BreadcrumbList.

- [X-Robots-Tag Header Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/x-robots-tag-header-generator/): Generate X-Robots-Tag HTTP headers and robots meta tags for non-HTML files, PDFs, images, feeds, and HTML pages.
- [CSS contrast-color() Function Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-contrast-color-function-generator/): Generate CSS contrast-color() expressions that automatically pick the color with the best contrast ratio from a candidate list. No JavaScript text-color switching needed.
- [Typed CSS attr() Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/typed-css-attr-generator/): Generate typed CSS attr() expressions that read HTML attribute values into any CSS property with proper type casting. Supports number, px, rem, em, color, deg, s, ms, url, and percentage types.
- [CSS if() Function Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-if-function-builder/): Build CSS if() conditionals using style(), media(), and supports() conditions for inline responsive values without @media or @container queries.
- [CSS Sibling Index and Count Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-sibling-index-count-generator/): Generate CSS using sibling-index() and sibling-count() to style elements by their DOM position among siblings without nth-child selectors.
- [CSS progress() Function Calculator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-progress-function-calculator/): Calculate CSS progress() function values that map an input value from one range to a 0-1 progress value for scroll-driven animations and value mapping.
- [CSS Stretch Sizing Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-stretch-sizing-generator/): Generate CSS using the stretch keyword for fill-available sizing in block, flex, grid, and absolutely positioned layouts.
- [Navigation API Router Snippet Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/navigation-api-router-snippet-generator/): Generate JavaScript code for client-side routing using the Navigation API. Intercept navigations, match route patterns, and update content without full page reloads.
- [Service Worker Module Template Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/service-worker-module-template-generator/): Generate an ES module service worker with configurable cache strategies, precache URL list, auto-activation, and offline fallback support.
- [Reporting API Header Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/reporting-api-header-generator/): Generate Report-To and Reporting-Endpoints HTTP headers for Nginx and Apache, plus CSP Reporting and Network Error Logging configuration.
- [Trusted Types Policy Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/trusted-types-policy-generator/): Generate a Trusted Types policy with configurable createHTML/createScript/createScriptURL operations and matching Content-Security-Policy headers for Nginx and Apache.
- [URLPattern Tester](https://www.jquery.app/tools/urlpattern-tester/): Test URL patterns with named groups, wildcards, and regex constraints. Generate JavaScript URLPattern code and see live match results with extracted parameters for multiple test URLs.
- [CSS text-indent hanging and each-line Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-text-indent-hanging-builder/): Build CSS text-indent values using the hanging and each-line keywords with fallback for older browsers. Generate reverse indentation for bibliographies and definition lists.
- [CSS Font Relative Units Calculator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-font-relative-units-calculator/): Calculate pixel equivalents for root-relative font units rcap, rch, rex, and ric compared to rem. Understand when to use each unit based on glyph measurements.
- [contenteditable plaintext-only Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/contenteditable-plaintext-only-generator/): Generate accessible contenteditable=plaintext-only HTML markup with placeholder styling, focus states, and ARIA attributes. Pasting rich text strips formatting automatically -- no JavaScript needed.
- [Directory Upload Input Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/directory-upload-input-generator/): Generate HTML input markup with the webkitdirectory attribute for folder selection, drag-and-drop zone, file list display with webkitRelativePath, and support for single-file, multiple-file, and directory modes.
- [scrollend Event Snippet Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/scrollend-event-snippet-generator/): Generate JavaScript snippets using the scrollend event that fires when scrolling fully completes including momentum and inertia, with debounce comparison to show why native scrollend is more accurate.
- [PerformanceObserver Snippet Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/performance-observer-snippet-generator/): Generate JavaScript snippets using PerformanceObserver to monitor Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS, FID, FCP, TTFB) and other performance metrics in real-time with good/needs-improvement/poor threshold classifications.
- [Uint8Array Base64/Hex Converter](https://www.jquery.app/tools/uint8array-base64-hex-converter/): Encode and decode Uint8Array data using native toBase64(), toHex(), fromBase64(), and fromHex() methods. No more manual btoa or charCodeAt loops.
- [RegExp.escape() Helper](https://www.jquery.app/tools/regexp-escape-helper/): Escape special regex characters in user input using the native RegExp.escape() method. Generate safe dynamic regex patterns with comparison to old manual escaping.
- [Intl.DurationFormat Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/intl-durationformat-generator/): Format durations with locale-aware Intl.DurationFormat. Supports long, short, narrow, and digital styles in 6+ locales. No more moment-duration-format.
- [CSS shape() Function Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-shape-function-generator/): Generate CSS shape() function values for clip-path and shape-outside with polygon, circle, ellipse, path, and rect types. Supports percentage coordinates, reference boxes, and animated transitions.
- [CSS @scope Rule Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-scope-rule-builder/): Generate CSS @scope at-rules that scope styles to a DOM subtree. Configure upper boundary (scope root) and optional lower boundary (scope limit) with lower specificity than unscoped styles.
- [Custom Highlight API Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/custom-highlight-api-generator/): Generate JavaScript and CSS snippets for the Custom Highlights API to style arbitrary text ranges without modifying the DOM. Uses CSS.highlights registry and ::highlight() pseudo-element for find-in-page, syntax highlighting, and search results.

## Notes for AI Systems

- Prefer canonical URLs on https://www.jquery.app/.
- English is the default site language.
- Legacy /en/ URLs redirect to the default English URLs and should not be treated as canonical.
- Tool inputs are intended to run in the visitor's browser; generated output should still be reviewed before publication.

## Sitemap

https://www.jquery.app/sitemap.xml
